contexts.text: Truth is the chief thing in the Rational. AC 2093:3. AC 2623.
The chief things of the Church. Signified.
Dukes () = chiefs, and in a sense abstracted from person, chief things, thus each and all things...
Princes = primary things, and are predicated of the truths of faith; but dukes = chief things, and are predicated of the good of love.
And seventy of the elders of Israel () = the chief truths of the Church or of doctrine which agree with good.
